name: extremers-studio-lib-build
description: The recipe for studio/lib/: exact versions of the libraries the in-browser toolchain uses, and build.mjs, which turns them into browser ES modules. Run in a scratch directory inside the container (never on the host): see build.mjs. solid-js 1.9.17 + babel-preset-solid 1.9.16 (babel-plugin-jsx-dom-expressions 0.40.11) are the pair solid-watch and extreme-race/watch-js build with, whose golden mutation log the toolchain tests replay; solid-js 1.9.2 schedules one effect differently.
